name: Lullaby in Blue
line: A blue hydrangea resting in a cloud of baby's breath.
body: Real hydrangea and baby's breath laid on a flatbed scanner, so the blooms stay crisp and the stems drift off into gray. Calm and cool, it suits a bedroom, a nursery, or a quiet reading corner.

name: Verse in Periwinkle
line: Loose hydrangea petals in periwinkle, cream, and soft violet.
body: Hundreds of single hydrangea petals scanned edge to edge, like a page of handwriting seen up close. Soft enough for a bedroom, with enough pattern to hold a hallway or a stairwell.

name: Fable in Powder Blue
line: Powder blue hydrangea florets with a single bare branch.
body: Hydrangea florets scanned close, with one woody stem running through them. A wide, gentle piece that sits well over a desk, a dresser, or a bed.

name: Aubade in Hydrangea
line: A single hydrangea head on pale gray, the way it looks at first light.
body: One whole hydrangea scanned on its stem, blue fading to cream at the edges. Simple and botanical, like a plate from an old field guide.

name: Pastoral in Green
line: Dark rose leaves on white, plain and graphic.
body: Only the leaves and stems of a rose, scanned on white so every serrated edge shows. A quiet green for a kitchen, a study, or a wall of books.

name: Idyll in Rose and Gold
line: Pink-edged rose petals and a gold chrysanthemum, up close.
body: A tumble of rose petals and one yellow mum, scanned so the near petals are sharp and the rest go soft. Warm and romantic without being sweet.

name: Ballad in Sunflower
line: Sunflowers, asters, and deep burgundy blooms pressed together.
body: A late-summer bouquet laid flat on the glass: dark sunflower faces, mauve asters, and a wine-colored bloom tucked in. Rich and autumnal for a kitchen or dining room.

name: Carol in Scarlet
line: A scarlet chrysanthemum among white daisies and evergreen.
body: One red spider mum surrounded by small white blooms and sprigs of green. It reads a little like a winter wreath, and makes an easy holiday gift.

name: Epistle in Coral
line: Coral spray roses, buds still closed, stems crossing in the dark.
body: Small bicolor roses scanned against shadow so the buds glow red and gold. Moody and warm, it suits a library wall, an entryway, or a dark-painted room.

name: Madrigal in Rose
line: White roses edged in pink, loosely gathered on blush.
body: Real picotee roses scanned on a pale pink ground, with petals lifting softly off the glass. A gentle piece for a bedroom, a vanity, or someone who keeps the flowers they're given.

name: Litany in Lavender
line: Lavender roses in full bloom, crowded edge to edge.
body: A full cluster of lavender roses scanned so the centers stay deep and the outer petals pale. Dusky and a little Victorian, at home beside old books and candlelight.

name: Vigil in Garnet
line: Garnet roses and sea lavender scattered over shadow.
body: Red roses and tiny pink sea lavender scanned against dark gray, so the reds look lit from within. The most dramatic of the Open Editions, made for a dark academia wall.

name: Duet in Wine and Rose
kind: Red and Pink Rose Scanography Print
line: Wine-dark roses pressed against soft pink ones.
body: Deep red and pale pink roses scanned close, petals overlapping. Lush and romantic, a good fit for a bedroom or as an anniversary gift.

name: Canticle in Lily
line: White lilies and one long green leaf on pale gray.
body: Lily buds scanned on their stem, quiet and upright, like a pressed specimen. Clean and calm for a bathroom-adjacent hall, a bedroom, or a minimalist wall.

name: Prelude in Gold
line: The edge of a sunflower, its petals blurring into gold.
body: One sunflower scanned so close that only its dark center and a fan of petals fit on the glass. Bright and simple, it brings warmth to a kitchen or a gray wall.

name: Aria in Honey
line: Honey-yellow roses floating on a blush ground.
body: A dozen yellow roses scanned face up, so they seem to hover over the pink. Soft and sunny, it works over a bed, a sofa, or a breakfast table.

name: Refrain in Honey
line: Yellow roses scattered across pale pink, a quieter second verse.
body: A looser arrangement of the same honey roses, with more space between the blooms. Pairs naturally with Aria in Honey as a set of two.
